probe_used.reason: A meaningful architecture-fidelity probe requires the real DwarfStar Q path with official-compatible Block1 FP8/BF16 checkpoint semantics. The pinned implementation is coupled to GGUF dense projection tensors and private ds41_gpu_graph buffers; a NumPy reimplementation or Q4/Q8 GGUF run would confound runtime architecture with model representation.
